crashInventory.name: Google Integration / Drive & Sheets Workspace Provisioning
crashInventory.uiEntry: Project Setup Wizard -> Step 6 (Google Drive) -> Workspace Integration View
crashInventory.asyncOperation: Fetch call to server endpoint creating Google Drive folder & Sheets
crashInventory.exception: TypeError / FetchError: Google API authentication failure or unhandled rejection
crashInventory.renderBoundary: None (uncaught async error / unhandled promise rejection leading to blank screen)
crashInventory.likelyRootCause: Missing server-side Google OAuth/Service Account credentials or unhandled API errors during provisioning.

crashInventory.name: Central Executive Dashboard
crashInventory.asyncOperation: Async collection reads yielding empty/undefined datasets on first load
crashInventory.exception: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length' or 'reduce')
crashInventory.renderBoundary: None (uncaught render exception in chart/metric aggregation)
crashInventory.likelyRootCause: Unhandled undefined/null array access during initial empty-state (0 projects, 0 trips) rendering in metric aggregators and chart components.
crashInventory.sharedDependency: Empty-state / undefined collection handling across data stores

crashInventory.name: Admin Console
crashInventory.hookInitialization: useState for active tab, users, pending requests, audit logs
crashInventory.asyncOperation: Firestore subscription/fetch for user profiles and pending access requests
crashInventory.exception: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'role' or 'createdAt')
crashInventory.likelyRootCause: Unvalidated properties on pending approval requests and user profiles resulting in runtime TypeError during tab rendering when collections are empty or missing fields.
crashInventory.sharedDependency: User profile & approval repository data assumptions

crashInventory.name: Data Quality Engine
crashInventory.hookInitialization: useState for quality context and validation rules
crashInventory.service: Data quality validation pipeline / fixture loaders
crashInventory.asyncOperation: Parsing sample quality context and validation metrics
crashInventory.exception: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined in SAMPLE_QUALITY_CONTEXT
crashInventory.likelyRootCause: Missing or malformed sample data fixtures and unhandled empty dataset states in the validation pipeline.

crashInventory.name: Trip Engine / FSM
crashInventory.exception: TypeError / Invalid state transition when active trip context is missing
crashInventory.likelyRootCause: Obsolete developer diagnostic tool executing state machine simulations outside active live trip context, destabilizing production navigation.

sharedFailureAnalysis.primaryCommonDependency: Absence of defensive empty-state guards (optional chaining/default arrays) and global React Error Boundaries, combined with strict data shape assumptions on empty Firestore collections.

googleWorkspace.failureTrace: Project Workspace -> Google Integration -> automatic provisioning -> /api/workspace/provision -> server/workspace.service.ts -> Google APIs / OAuth
googleWorkspace.rootCause: Missing server-side Google OAuth/Service Account credentials or unhandled API rejections during automatic workspace provisioning.
googleWorkspace.recommendation: Ensure graceful fallback and clear error banners when service account keys are absent in development or sandboxed environments.

centralDashboard.zeroStateResilience: Fails when collections are empty due to lack of fallback empty arrays (e.g., trips ?? []). Must conceptually render cleanly with 0 projects, 0 trips, 0 exceptions, and 0 pricing rules.

adminConsole.failureFocus: Unvalidated user profile properties and pending approval requests causing render-time TypeErrors when lists are empty or contain legacy documents.

dataQualityEngine.rootCause: Dependency on SAMPLE_QUALITY_CONTEXT fixtures rather than robust empty-state initialization.

tripEngine.classification: Developer-only diagnostic tool. Obsolete for daily operations after Block 89B robust trip numbering and FSM integration. Recommended to isolate behind developer mode toggles.

errorBoundary.status: Lacks a global React Error Boundary wrapping the application shell and major views, resulting in unhandled rendering exceptions escalating into blank (black/white) screens.

systemToolsImportance.explanation: Operations Dashboard, Project Workspace, and Import Center are essential daily tools. Admin Console and Security Audit are administrative. Data Quality and Trip Engine are developer-only diagnostics.
